ai.title: Prefill email in referrals limit increase form
ai.summary: The 'Request limit increase' link in web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx now appends a query parameter to the Retool form URL. The parameter uses the current user's email from the session. This reduces manual input for authenticated users.

eli5.text: When you click "Request limit increase" on the referrals page, the form you land on now opens with your email already filled in, so you don't have to type it yourself. This happens because the page knows which email address you're signed in with and sends it along automatically.
